summary: an operator hold at <flumeDir>/held/<phase> outranks a handoff's wake, and every declined wake is reported with its reason
acceptance: a handoff naming a held phase does not wake it and the verdict says why; the supervisor and a bare tick decline a held phase while `flume tick --phase` runs it
tests: a held phase is not woken by a handoff that returns its name
the tick verdict names each declined wake and the reason it was declined
a humanOnly phase a handoff returns is reported as a declined wake
the supervisor does not start a held phase
a bare flume tick does not run a held phase
flume tick --phase runs a held phase
notes: The marker file is the mechanism; the verb is a sibling entry. A handoff never removes a hold — the hold is the operator's, and the wake a handoff performs is not the verb.
